_comment: The Liscor sewers (~20x14, cave biome). Entered from the street `sewer_grate` prop once `heard_about_cisterns` is banked (C3 banks it from Olesm) -- see the door_when seam on that prop + wi_game.gd's prop-interact branch. Water channels are walls.segments on the free_pack Water_tiles sheet, so world.gd's `_build_water_shimmer` paints the shimmer overlay automatically (sheet-match) AND they block movement (segment_cells joins the sim blocked set). Left (x0-2) and right (x17-19) walkways cross the two channels. Dark mood pin lives in data/moods.json; lights glow at dusk/night (light_energy_by_phase day=0.0), while the always-on pond_glints/dust ambience carries the day-phase atmosphere.
_comment_freezable: The channel-A/B cells at column x=3 the frost skill can turn to walkable ice, making a vertical SHORTCUT down the left side from the top band straight through both channels to the mid/lower bands (otherwise you must go around via the y11 row). Both are already blocked water (they sit under the channel walls.segments), so unfrozen they are byte-identical to today -- no route changes for any script that never casts frost here. Frozen ice thaws at the next sleep. sewers_walkthrough demos freezing (3,5).

floor_layers._pick: cave-floor variation reusing the cave biome's verified floor-tile neighborhood.

segments._comment: Water channel A (upper). Water_tiles sheet -> auto shimmer overlay + blocking.

entities._comment: The way back up. Returns to the street beside the sewer_grate (15,11); the grate is the sole street<->sewers link, so exit lands at the grate regardless.

A collapsed pile of rotten timber and tar-soaked rope blocking the dead-end side-nook WEST of the ladder (x0-1, off every canonical route -- cisterns/deep_descent only tread the x2 column and the y11 row, never x0-1, so this prop changes no other script's pathing or entity assertions). `burnable: true` is the ONLY tag the fire field seam keys on; facing it and casting [Firefly] removes it permanently (removed_entities, saved) and clears the nook. NOT a quest prop -- burning it costs nothing but the passage. Sprite `crate` is a debris stand-in (VISUAL-LOG flag, drainage_marker/nest_ledge precedent).
entities.observe: A slumped heap of waterlogged timber and old rope, tarred black and long dead. It chokes the little side-nook past the ladder. Dry enough on top to take a flame, if you had one.
entities.burn_toast: [Firefly] — Fire catches the tarred rope and runs greedily through the pile. In moments it is ash and the nook stands open, breathing cold sewer air.
entities.locked_toast: Sodden timber and tarred rope, jammed wall to wall. You could haul at it for an hour, or you could burn it, if you had the means to make fire.

entities.observe: Pale green moss crusts the old brick in patches, breathing a cold light that never quite reaches the water. Drakes farmed it once, they say, to see down here without lanterns.
entities.toast: Phosphor moss clings to the brick, glowing a sick, cold green. Cool to the touch, and it hisses faintly when your shadow crosses it.

entities.observe: A carved stone boundary marker, Drake glyphs worn shallow. It counts cisterns and sluice-gates in a hand two centuries dead. Someone scratched a newer mark beside it: a spider, hastily.
entities.toast: An old Drake drainage marker, its glyphs half-swallowed by grime. You can just make out a map of channels — and a fresh scratch, shaped like a spider, gouged over the third cistern.

entities.observe: A market crate, swollen and burst, washed down through a grate above. Whatever was in it fed something down here long ago.
entities.toast: A ruined crate, half-sunk in silt. Merchant stamps still show under the rot: lost cargo, swallowed by the sewers and picked clean.

entities.observe: Cable-thick silk, black-and-silver banded, stretched wall to wall. Not a house spider's work. Something with a shield on its back spun this, and recently.
entities.toast: Ropes of banded silk choke the side passage, strong as wire. Wrapped in it, drained pale: a rat, a boot, something that used to be a Watchman's lantern.

entities._comment: The sewers' easy trash fight -- the sewers_walkthrough clears it (autoplay). Interact-only (no trigger_radius) so QA controls when it starts.

The Shield Spider nest -- Quest 1 'Something in the Cisterns' FIGHT path (C3 wires the quest; on_victory banks cleared_the_nest for C3 to read). Interact-only (no trigger_radius) so C3's SKILL path can [Appraise Foe] the nest without triggering combat. Phosphor_pendant loot rides the sewers-phosphor prop fiction. This encounter carried NO loot table before G2 (confirmed by grep), so the new table is purely additive -- no prior loot draw exists at any pinned seed for this entity to disturb. Loot RNG is isolated (hash(run_seed, encounter_id), M7), so this can never shift the main event stream or any OTHER encounter's draw. Chance 0.3 is a G2 pick (the staging doc names the source but not a chance value) -- mid-range between the shipped 0.25/0.5 precedents. Issue #69: Klbkch fields here (the cisterns quest's FIGHT path), NOT Relc -- this is Klbkch's own alternation slot alongside crate_scavengers (Relc keeps the tutorial/road/inn fights + the descent). Was `allies: []` before this lane (no ally ever fielded here despite sim_combat_batch.gd's pre-existing `shield_spiders_w2_relc` harness cell, which was always a measured-only hypothetical, never wired to this entity) -- no swap needed, this is a net-new gate, and that pre-existing relc cell is now stale documentation of an unwired hypothetical, kept for the record. `ally_requires: {chatted_with_klbkch: 1}` is banked ONLY by talking to Klbkch at the gate (#51's talk_pool). Balance: sim_combat_batch.gd ENCOUNTER_CELLS `shield_spiders_w2_klbkch` (measured-only, same rationale as the `_w2_solo`/`_w1_solo` siblings -- cisterns_fight's own pinned fixture rng_state is the real content proof, not a win-rate contract).
entities.observe: Two of them, banded carapaces catching the moss-light, waiting where the silk is thickest. Their legs test the air toward you. Behind them the tunnel drops away, and more eyes catch the light down there than you want to count.

entities._comment: Quest 1 SKILL path: the walkway ledge overlooking the Shield Spider nest. Mirrors the crate quest's cellar_door [Light] shape -- `requires_skill: observe` + `on_skill_use` banks `scouted_the_nest` deterministically (single accomplishment, zero rng). Both interact (E, facing it -> interact()'s prop branch use_skill('observe', id) fallback) and the field [Appraise Foe] hotbar (use_skill_field -> the requires_skill==observe && on_skill_use branch) route through the SAME use_skill seam, so the bank + toast are identical either way; the generic observe-string path never fires for this prop (the requires_skill+on_skill_use branch is checked first). `locked_toast` gates gracefully when [Appraise Foe] is unknown (no skill-name leak). Placed at (17,10) on the right walkway, one cell east of the open nest floor -- reachable WITHOUT interacting the interact-only shield_spiders at (15,10), so scouting never trips the fight. Sprite `boulder` is a stand-in (a broken brick lip) consistent with the drainage_marker; VISUAL-LOG flag.
entities.skill_hint_toast: A perfect vantage over the nest, for a trained eye.

on_skill_use.toast: [Appraise Foe] — You lie flat on the ledge and read the nest like a map. Two sentries on the silk, a brood-hollow behind them, and a tunnel dropping away toward the Dungeon proper. That's where the rest of them are. Count, size, exits: you have it all, and you never had to draw a blade.

entities.locked_toast: The ledge overlooks the nest: a perfect vantage, if you had the eye to read one. You don't, quite. Not yet.

entities._comment: The descent seam, gated on Act III's tremor beat. A `door_when` prop on the SAME idiom as the street sewer_grate: its gate is `heard_the_deep_tremor` -- Zevara's post-Act-II summons is its SOLE producer (documented in CLAUDE.md). Until banked, door_when is UNMET and interact falls through to on_interact_accomplishment + toast (found_the_fissure) -- pre-gate behavior is byte-identical, so sewers_walkthrough/cisterns_* stay green. Once banked, the same interact emits open_toast and descends to deep_tunnels (2,2). Placed at (8,12), the untouched bottom-middle band -- no sewers/cisterns route asserts or treads a bottom-band cell (all sewers-map cells they visit are top-band y2, the nest right-side y10, and (2,7)). Sprite `boulder` is a rubble stand-in for a collapsed fissure (VISUAL-LOG flag, drainage_marker/nest_ledge precedent).
entities.observe: The floor gave way here, not long ago: a raw crack breathing air colder and older than the sewers ever hold. The claw-scores on its lip all point one way: down. Something climbed up through this, and means to again.
entities.toast: A fresh fissure splits the sewer floor, exhaling a dry, breathing cold from far below. Deep gouges rake the stone lip. Something big has been using this as a door.

door_when.open_toast: You lower yourself into the fissure. The sewer's damp falls away behind you, and a dry, ancient cold rises to meet your hands. The dark below swallows the last of the light from above.

entities._comment: Issue #81 lore-note collectible thread: found-note item (kind:parcel, data/items.json), container shape (contains). Placed at (9,1), the upper room above the y5 water-channel wall segment -- confirmed off every sewers-touching canonical's actual walked-cell set (sewers_walkthrough/cisterns_fight/cisterns_scout together only tread (15,9)/(15,11)/(2,2)/(1,2)/(3,4)/(3,5)/(5,2)/(6,2)/(16,10)/(18,10) in this map; cisterns_talk never physically enters sewers; deep_descent's fixture starts already adjacent to deep_fissure at (8,11) and never walks elsewhere). No gate -- an always-findable secondary discovery, like phosphor_moss/drainage_marker.
entities.observe: A single page, gone soft with damp, wedged where the old brick has cracked.

entities._comment: Issue #81 'The Missing Recruit' mini-quest (data/quests.json, the_missing_recruit): the beat-1 discovery, a `present_when`-gated NPC (STRUCTURAL absence, not merely visual -- entity_present's own doc comment in wi_game.gd) so a player can never stumble on Pell before Dresk's barracks conversation has actually opened the quest. Gate: `missing_recruit_started` (Dresk's dresk_recruit.json 'ask' option, banked on the BARRACKS map) -- a DIFFERENT map than this entity's own (sewers), satisfying present_when's same-map-producer constraint. Placed at (11,3), the SAME upper room as note_sewer_surveyor above, off every sewers canonical's walked-cell set (see that entity's own comment) -- none of them bank missing_recruit_started, so Pell stays structurally absent in every pre-#81 sewers script, and their `ui_entities_rendered` sprite counts are untouched by this addition (unlike note_sewer_surveyor, which IS always-present and therefore DOES bump the raw entity count -- no pre-#81 sewers script asserts that count today, so nothing needed updating). No talk_pool (met once, present_when already keeps a random early explorer from ever reaching this node pre-quest) -- a bare `conversation` routes every interact straight to recruit_pell.json.

dialogue.speaker: Pell
dialogue.text: I'm fine. Really. Just — turned around in the dark, that's all.

entities._comment: R6 (#95) trap placement 1/2: sewer_vermin nest approach snag. Shape = requires_skill disarm (dart_slit_a precedent) -- E-interact always shows the tell (skill_hint_toast/locked_toast) regardless of disarm ability. Cell (7,3) verified off every sewers canonical's real walked-cell set: sewers_walkthrough treads (1-6,2)+(3,3-5); missing_recruit_loop treads row y4 x2-9 + col x9 y2-4 + (10,3); cisterns_scout/cisterns_fight tread col x2 y2-11 + row y11; deep_descent only touches (8,11) -- re-run all five after this edit, zero re-pin needed. requires_skill=observe LIVE (disarm_trap PARKED pending Rogue L5 -- docs/design/class-foundation-staging/trap-disarm-swap.json). Avoidable: single-cell prop on open floor (sewers has no `blocked` list, only wall segments + entity occupancy), adjacent cells (6,3)/(8,3)/(7,4) all clear -- trap_canonical proves the walk-around. Disarm banks shared `trap_disarmed` (Rogue axis feeder, produced-but-unconsumed today, verified legal) + 1g salvage.
entities.skill_hint_toast: Wire, taut and low, strung off a rusted stanchion. Something in the nest rigged this. Careful hands could clear it.
entities.locked_toast: A length of wire runs low across the passage, pinned to a rusted stanchion. Whatever it's meant to catch, you can't tell how to spring it safe.

on_skill_use.toast: You ease the wire off its catch and coil it loose. A few scavenged links clatter free, worth a coin or two melted down.

entities._comment: R6 (#95) trap placement 2/2: shield_spiders/nest_ledge approach snag, south flank away from the y11 walkway cisterns_scout/cisterns_fight both walk edge to edge. Cell (13,12) verified off every sewers canonical's walked-cell set (same trace as sewer_nest_snag above) -- y12 is untouched except (18,12), no entity sits at (13,12). requires_skill=observe LIVE (disarm_trap PARKED, same staging doc). Avoidable: single-cell prop, (12,12)/(14,12)/(13,11) all clear. Disarm banks shared trap_disarmed + 1g.
entities.skill_hint_toast: Bone and wire, tangled at the drain mouth, rigged for something bigger than rats. A steady hand could clear it.
entities.locked_toast: Bone and wire, tangled at the drain mouth. It has the shape of a trap. You can't read it well enough to touch it.

on_skill_use.toast: You work the bone pins loose and unwind the wire. A few coins sit wedged in the silt beneath it, dropped by whoever it once caught.
